facts.fact: 四个女孩找到 Otley Road 这处房子时一致认为它完美。
facts.anchor: The place was perfect, that was what they all said when they found it.

facts.fact: 只有 Olivia 会被脏沙发与褪色窗帘打动，愿意把破败看成诗意。
黄金地段的学生房产租金却便宜得出奇。
facts.anchor: It was surprisingly cheap, this slice of prime student real estate they had been so lucky to find.

facts.fact: 她们没有追问便宜的原因，照中介的催促抢先签了合同。
facts.anchor: Instead of considering why, the girls had blindly taken the advice of the estate agent, to hurry and sign the contract before anyone else.

facts.fact: 门楣上那尊石头怪兽少了半张脸，被她们当成滑稽的吉祥物。
facts.anchor: Half its face was missing, lending it a comic, gruesome demeanour.

facts.fact: 抽外卖单分房间时，Olivia 抽到组合最离谱的一张，因此先挑房间。
facts.anchor: A menu for an outlet selling pizzas, burgers, kebabs, curries and, get this, mushy peas.

facts.fact: 她挑临街大房间，是希望进出必经的位置能让她在团体里站稳。
facts.anchor: She hoped that taking the room near the entrance would secure her place in the group.

facts.fact: 她最怕的是被忽略、从平等成员降为跟班。
facts.anchor: They’d find it harder to forget about her, which was what she feared most.

facts.fact: 平淡的暑假里她下定决心：第二年要属于她，要更大胆。
facts.anchor: Second year would be her year, she decided during an uneventful summer back home.
